text.en: A Tamil poem in praise of the holy city of Kasi.

Kasikandam is a Tamil poetic work, composed by Athiveerarama Pandiyan, that is based on the Sanskrit Kasi Khanda and describes the greatness of the city of Kasi. The textbook includes a poem to be memorised.
The poem teaches the Tamil tradition of hospitality and charity through the verse selected here. Read its meaning in your textbook.
Terms: காண்டம் (section or canto), காசி (Kasi) and மனப்பாடம். Learn the poem along with its meaning.
